name: Smoked Salmon-Quinoa Bowl with Pickled Veggies, Avocado & Tahini Sauce

instructions.primary_message: In a medium saucepan, combine broth and quinoa; bring the mixture to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer until liquid is fully absorbed, about 15 minutes. Remove from heat and let stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
710 ml chicken or vegetable broth
1 ½ cups quinoa

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ English cucumbers
1 ½ bunches radish
1 ½ lemons
3 (2 ½ cm) pieces ginger root
3 avocados

instructions.primary_message: Place vinegar, honey, and salt in a medium bowl. Whisk to combine the pickling liquid.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup red wine vinegar
2 tbsp honey
1 ½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Trim and slice cucumbers and radishes crosswise into thin rounds. Add both to the bowl with the pickling liquid, stir to combine, and set aside.
Juice lemons into a small bowl.
Peel and mince ginger and garlic. Add both to the bowl with the lemon juice along with oil, tahini, soy sauce, and pepper. Whisk to combine the sauce and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cloves garlic
⅓ cup extra virgin olive oil
¼ cup tahini
3 tbsp soy sauce
3 pinch black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Right before serving, halve and pit avocados; using a spoon, scoop out the flesh and slice crosswise into thin half-moons.
To serve, divide quinoa, pickled veggies, avocado, and smoked salmon between bowls. Drizzle with sauce and enjoy!
